subject: Mythology
title: The Churning of the Ocean
description: One-minute skill: The Churning of the Ocean.

hook.text: Gods and demons worked together to churn a cosmic ocean, hoping to produce the elixir of immortality.

buildup.text: They used a mountain as the churning rod and a giant serpent as the rope, pulling back and forth for eons.

discovery.text: Treasures emerged: the moon, a wish-granting tree, divine weapons, and finally the elixir of immortality itself.

twist.text: Deadly poison also emerged. Shiva drank it to save the world, turning his throat permanently blue.

climax.text: Vishnu tricked the demons out of the elixir, ensuring only the gods gained immortality from their shared labor.

punchline.text: They worked together, and only one side got the reward.

quiz.question: Why is Shiva's throat blue in Hindu iconography?
options: He was born that way as a sign of divine power
He drank deadly poison from the ocean churning to save the world
A curse from Brahma turned his skin blue
